title: Owner Auto Policy Rated Driver Schedule: Listing, Adding and Removing Drivers
content:
**Listing.** Every resident of the household at or above the household listing age is listed on the Owner Auto Policy, either as a rated driver or as a named excluded driver.

**Adding a rated driver.**
- A driver is added as a rated driver only when the driver's violation points do not exceed the package's maximum points (the new-business figure in the package acceptability schedule). This is read from the driver's recorded points and the term's package.
- The rated drivers on the term may not exceed the package's maximum rated drivers.
- A driver who would exceed either limit is offered exclusion, or the term moves to the highest lower package whose limits are met.

**Effective date of an add.**
- The clause "A driver is added effective the date the change is requested, never earlier" is no longer in force as a rule for every add.
- The listing that precedes the exclusion of the resident named on the term's latest Named Driver Exclusion form takes effect on the date set for it, when that resident is reported operating while unlisted and carries no driver-added entry on the term.
- The re-listing of the household resident on the term's latest claim report recording an unlisted household resident takes effect on the date set for it, when that resident was rated earlier in the term by a driver-added entry and is not the resident named on the latest form.
- The lift of the exclusion of the driver on the term's latest claim report recording a named excluded driver keeps its own rule.
- Every other driver is still added effective the date the change is requested, never earlier.
- Lifting an exclusion is an add, with a prior status of excluded.

**Removing a driver.**
- The named insured states that the driver no longer lives in the household and does not drive any scheduled vehicle. This rests on the named insured's statement.
- A removal takes effect on the date requested, never earlier than the request.
- It returns premium pro rata of the driver's full-term premium share.
- The named insured is never removed.

**Points boundary (hypothetical, Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability, 16-point maximum).**

| Driver's points | Added as rated driver |
|---|---|
| 16 | Yes |
| 17 | No; exclusion is offered, or a lower package whose limits are met |

superseded_clauses: A driver is added effective the date the change is requested, never earlier;
